purpose: Form INC-6 is used for filing an application for the conversion of a company, such as converting a One Person Company into a Private or Public Company.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Alter the memorandum and articles by passing a resolution.
Increase the minimum number of members and directors as required.
Maintain the minimum paid-up capital as per the requirements of the Act.
Make due compliance of section 18 of the Act for conversion.
File an application in e-Form No. INC-6 along with fees and altered e-MOA and e-AOA.
checklist: Compliance with section 18 of the Act
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
